user.title: Connect to BInformed
user.description: Enter the API key of your BInformed account. It is shown in your account on binformed.gericos.com once you sign up, and starts with `gn_`.

data_description.api_key: The key is sent as the `X-API-Key` header on every request. No test notification is sent while checking it.
data_description.name: Name of the notify entity, useful when several BInformed accounts are configured.
data_description.base_url: Only change this if you run your own BInformed instance.
